contains-crystalline-silica-free-quartz-: Kuqukethe i-silica eyikristalu (i-quartz ekhululekile engu-10-15% ngokwedatha yeshidi); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
200-mesh-flotation-grade-soda-feldspar-n: I-soda feldspar ye-200-mesh yebanga le-flotation evela eSpruce Pine, NC, phambilini eyayibizwa ngokuthi yi-NC-4. Iyona ejwayelekile e-US engena esikhundleni se-Kona F-4.
contains-crystalline-silica-about-10-qua: Kuqukethe i-silica eyikristalu (cishe i-quartz engu-10% ngokwe-SDS); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.

covia-states-there-is-no-free-1893lq7: I-Covia ithi ayikho i-silica eyikristalu ekhululekile (<0.1%), kodwa gwema ukuhogela uthuli.

needle-shaped-acicular-mineral-dust-avoi: Uthuli lweminerali olumise okwezinaliti (acicular); gwema ukuluhogela.

a-cornwall-stone-replacement-from-hammil: Okungena esikhundleni se-Cornwall stone okuvela ku-Hammill & Gillespie, okwakheke cishe nge-quartz engu-20%, i-albite engu-52% ne-orthoclase engu-27%. Ngokungafani ne-Cornish stone yangempela, engakaze imbiwe kusukela ngo-2006, ayiqukethe i-fluorine.
contains-crystalline-silica-about-20-qua: Kuqukethe i-silica eyikristalu (cishe i-quartz engu-20%); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.

high-potash-feldspar-that-laguna-sold-1a: I-feldspar ene-potash eningi i-Laguna eyayithengisa njenge-''G-200 New Potash'' ngemuva kokuphela kwengxube ye-G-200 yokuqala. a-popular-north-american-soda-feldspar-1: I-soda feldspar edumile yaseNyakatho Melika engasenziwa; i-Minspar 200 inamakhemikhali afana kakhulu futhi iyona evame ukungena esikhundleni sayo.
a-fluorine-bearing-lithium-potassium-mic: I-lithium-potassium mica ephethe i-fluorine, kade ingatholakali kubabumbi base-US. Ayikho engena ngqo esikhundleni sayo; thola i-Li2O ku-spodumene, ku-petalite noma ku-lithium carbonate, ne-K2O ku-potash feldspar.
jeff-zamek-s-1997-guide-to-plkif7: Umhlahlandlela kaJeff Zamek ka-1997 wokushintshanisa ku-Ceramics Monthly wawusuthi isiyekiwe ukwenziwa.
contains-fluorine-which-is-released-as-1: Kuqukethe i-fluorine, ekhishwa njengentuthu ngesikhathi sokushisa futhi engabangela amabhamuza nemigodi emincane ku-glaze; ngenisa umoya ku-kiln.
a-water-washed-secondary-kaolin-from-1i5: I-kaolin yesibili egezwe ngamanzi evela e-Edgar, eFlorida, kade iyi-kaolin ejwayelekile ye-glaze e-US ngoba igcina ama-glaze exubekile kahle futhi ishisa ibe mhlophe. an-air-floated-georgia-kaolin-and-1f3wll: I-kaolin yaseGeorgia ehlungwe ngomoya (air-floated) futhi iyi-kaolin ethambe kakhulu ethengiswa kakhulu eNyakatho Melika. a-325-mesh-calcined-kaolin-made-843pbe: I-calcined kaolin ye-325-mesh eyenzelwe upende futhi ethengiswa abaphakeli bezinto zokubumba base-US njenge-calcined kaolin yabo. a-plastic-buff-firing-missouri-fireclay-: I-fireclay yaseMissouri ethambile, eshisa ibe ngu-buff, ethengiswa igaywe ku-20, 35, 40 naku-50 mesh. Ikakhulu iwubumba lwesimbumba; amanani avamile kobumba lwemvelo.
a-blended-iron-bearing-slip-clay-1wfl7qj: I-slip clay exutshiwe ephethe i-iron i-Plainsman eyenzayo kusukela ngo-1988 esikhundleni se-Albany slip. Iyodwa incibilika ibe nsundu ecwebezelayo ku-cone 10 (i-tenmoku ku-reduction) futhi idinga cishe i-frit engu-20% ku-cone 6; sebenzisa ingxube eyosiwe neluhlaza ezindleleni zokwenza ezinamaphesenti aphezulu ukuze ugweme imifantu yokoma.
a-silty-iron-rich-new-york-oucatm: Ubumba lwaseNew York olunodaka, olune-iron eningi olwalincibilika lodwa lube yi-glaze ensundu emnyama ecwebezelayo ku-cone 8 kuya ku-10 futhi luvela ezinkulungwaneni zezindlela zokwenza ezindala. Alusenziwa kusukela ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yawo-1980; sebenzisa i-Alberta Slip esikhundleni salo.
leadless-low-alumina-calcium-sodium-boro: I-calcium-sodium borosilicate frit engenamthofu, ene-alumina encane; i-frit esetshenziswa kakhulu ezindleleni zokwenza ama-glaze zaseNyakatho Melika, ikakhulu njengomthombo we-boron ne-calcium. Fusion 1450 F, flow 1600 F, CTE 9.47 (Ferro 2008).
non-hazardous-glass-powder-per-supplier-: Impuphu yengilazi engenangozi ngokwe-SDS yomphakeli; gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
calcium-borosilicate-frit-with-a-balance: I-calcium borosilicate frit enamakhemikhali alinganiselayo afana ne-glaze (iqukethe cishe i-alumina engu-10%); ne-kaolin encane icishe ibe yi-glaze ephelele ye-low-fire. Fusion 1600 F, flow 1750 F, CTE 7.94 (Ferro 2008).
high-sodium-low-boron-high-expansion-ggm: I-frit ene-sodium eningi, i-boron encane nokwanda okukhulu; umthombo ovamile we-soda kuwo wonke amazinga okushisa nakuma-glaze e-crystalline. Fusion 1400 F, flow 1700 F, CTE 10.08 (Ferro 2008).
well-balanced-high-boron-calcium-borosil: I-calcium borosilicate frit elinganiselwe kahle ene-boron eningi; cishe i-frit engu-85 ne-kaolin engu-15 kwenza i-glaze ecwebile ye-cone 04. Fusion 1500 F, flow 1700 F, CTE 7.16 (Ferro 2008).
alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: I-magnesia borosilicate frit engenayo i-alkali enokwanda okuphansi kakhulu ekushiseni (i-CTE cishe engu-4.0); isetshenziswa ku-3-10% ukwelapha i-crazing futhi njengomthombo we-MgO oncibilika kalula. Fusion 1900 F, flow 2300 F (Ferro 2003).
high-alkali-almost-calcium-free-alkali-3: I-alkali borosilicate frit ene-alkali eningi, ecishe ingenayo i-calcium, ene-zinc ne-fluorine encane; ukwanda okukhulu, isetshenziselwa ama-glaze e-crackle nama-glaze anemibala ye-alkaline. Fusion 1400 F, flow 1500 F, CTE 9.98 (Ferro 2008).
contains-about-1-5-fluorine-which-q7b1ho: Kuqukethe cishe i-fluorine engu-1.5%, engakhishwa ngesikhathi sokushisa; ngenisa umoya ku-kiln. Ngaphandle kwalokho iyimpuphu yengilazi enengozi encane.
artware-flux-calcium-borosilicate-frit-f: I-calcium borosilicate frit eyi-flux ye-artware; i-Fusion iyibala njengelingana ne-Vibrantz 3134. Uma iqhathaniswa ne-3134-2 (Ferro 2008): Al2O3 -1.20, B2O3 +1.01, SiO2 -0.56, CaO +0.49, Na2O +0.26 amaphoyinti; incibilika igeleze kancane ngaphezulu.
boro-calcium-dinnerware-frit-fusion-s-lb: I-boro-calcium frit yezitsha zokudla; i-Fusion iyibala njengelingana ne-Vibrantz 3124. Uma iqhathaniswa ne-3124-2 (Ferro 2008): B2O3 +0.86, K2O -0.68 (ayikho ku-F-19), Na2O +0.60, SiO2 -0.44, Al2O3 -0.31 amaphoyinti; igeleza kancane ngaphezulu.
high-calcium-boron-leadless-frit-fusion-: I-boron frit engenamthofu ene-calcium eningi; i-Fusion iyibala njengelingana ne-Vibrantz 3195. Iyona engafani kahle kunazo zonke lezi: uma iqhathaniswa ne-3195-2 (Ferro 2008) ine-K2O +3.70, Na2O -2.69, B2O3 -2.32, Al2O3 +1.52, CaO -0.86, SiO2 +0.65 amaphoyinti.
high-sodium-low-boron-frit-fusion-16l28b: I-frit ene-sodium eningi ne-boron encane; i-Fusion iyibala njengelingana ne-Vibrantz 3110 futhi iyona esondele kakhulu kunazo zonke lezi: yonke i-oxide iphakathi kwamaphoyinti angu-0.26 e-3110-2 (Ferro 2008). Igeleza kancane ngaphezulu futhi ine-surface tension ephansi.
alkali-free-magnesia-borosilicate-frit-w: I-magnesia borosilicate frit engenayo i-alkali enokwanda okuphansi kakhulu (CTE 3.96), esetshenziselwa ukulwa ne-crazing; i-Fusion iyibala njengelingana ne-Vibrantz 3249. Uma iqhathaniswa ne-3249 ayinayo i-CaO (-3.50 amaphoyinti), SiO2 +2.40, B2O3 +1.30, Al2O3 -0.80, MgO +0.60.
natural-sodium-calcium-borate-ore-colema: Itshe lemvelo le-sodium-calcium borate (i-colemanite ne-ulexite nobumba obufana ne-hectorite), kade liyi-boron flux eyinhloko ye-low-fire ne-mid-fire ezindleleni zokwenza zase-US. Imayini yavalwa ngo-2000; okusele kuncane futhi kuyabiza, futhi i-Gillespie Borate iyona etuswayo ukungena esikhundleni sayo ngesisindo esifanayo.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-kpnwt9: I-borate: ungayigwinyi; izifundo zezilwane ezinomthamo omkhulu wama-borate e-inorganic zibonisa imiphumela ekuzaleni/ekukhuleni (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Gwema ukuhogela uthuli. Umphakeli unesexwayiso se-California Prop 65 se-silica eyikristalu.
blended-borate-mainly-ulexite-with-some-: I-borate exutshiwe (ikakhulu i-ulexite ne-colemanite ethile kanye nezinto ezifana nobumba ezicishe zibe ngu-10%) eyenzelwe ukungena esikhundleni se-Gerstley Borate ngesisindo esifanayo; okwamanje iyakhiqizwa futhi ithengiswa e-US, e-UK naseYurophu.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-havqf3: I-borate: ungayigwinyi; izifundo zezilwane ezinomthamo omkhulu wama-borate e-inorganic zibonisa imiphumela ekuzaleni/ekukhuleni (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
legacy-blended-gerstley-borate-substitut: Okuxubile okudala okwakungena esikhundleni se-Gerstley Borate, okwakuthengiswa yi-Laguna ngeminyaka yawo-2000; kugcine kuphela ezindleleni zokwenza ezindala. Kwakudinga izingxenye ezingu-6-8 ze-bentonite noma ze-hectorite kwezingu-100 ukuze kufane nokuxubeka kwe-Gerstley Borate; i-Gillespie Borate iyona engena esikhundleni sayo manje.
laguna-withdrew-it-in-2012-its-13jz0u3: I-Laguna yayihoxisa ngo-2012: ishidi layo lokuphepha lathathelwa indawo ngoMeyi walowo nyaka yinothi elithi, njengoba i-Gerstley Borate yayisitholakala kakhulu futhi, i-Laguna Borate yayingasatholakali.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-13mdgfk: I-borate: ungayigwinyi; izifundo zezilwane ezinomthamo omkhulu wama-borate e-inorganic zibonisa imiphumela ekuzaleni/ekukhuleni (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Gwema ukuhogela uthuli. I-MSDS ye-Laguna ibala i-silica eyikristalu ne-calcium carbonate.
legacy-plastic-gerstley-borate-substitut: Okudala okuthambile okwakungena esikhundleni se-Gerstley Borate, okwakhiwa yi-Plainsman Clays ngo-2000 futhi kwathengiswa ekuqaleni kweminyaka yawo-2000; akusenziwa. Kugcine kuphela ezindleleni zokwenza ezindala; i-Gillespie Borate iyona engena esikhundleni sayo manje.
plainsman-s-materials-page-listed-it-388: Ikhasi lokokwakha le-Plainsman lalikubala kwaze kwaba sekupheleni kuka-2017 futhi lalingasakubali ngoJanuwari 2018.
commercial-turkish-sodium-calcium-borate: Itshe le-sodium-calcium borate lokuhweba laseTurkey, elithengiswa ligayiwe (amabanga angu-75 no-45 micron); umthombo we-boron oluhlaza osetshenziswa ikakhulu ngababumbi baseYurophu nabaseRussia nasezintweni ezenziwe ekhaya ezingena esikhundleni se-Gerstley Borate. Lincibilika kancane emanzini futhi lilahlekelwa cishe ingxenye yesithathu yesisindo salo ekushiseni.
borate-do-not-ingest-high-dose-1q1jdvy: I-borate: ungayigwinyi; izifundo zezilwane ezinomthamo omkhulu wama-borate e-inorganic zibonisa imiphumela ekuzaleni/ekukhuleni (U.S. Borax Gerstley Borate MSDS, Apr 2013). Gwema ukuhogela uthuli. I-SDS ye-Etimine (rev. Oct 2021) iyibala njengengahlukaniswanga njengengozi ngaphansi kwe-UN GHS.
aluminum-hydroxide-powder-used-to-add-8q: Impuphu ye-aluminum hydroxide esetshenziselwa ukwengeza i-alumina kuma-glaze naku-kiln wash naku-wadding; ixubeka futhi inamathela kangcono kune-calcined alumina. Ilahlekelwa cishe ngu-35% wesisindo sayo njengamanzi eduze kuka-220-300 C.
calcined-aluminum-oxide-ground-to-325-43: I-calcined aluminum oxide egaywe kwaze kwaba -325 mesh; imelana kakhulu nokushisa (incibilika cishe ku-2040 C), isetshenziselwa ukwenza ama-glaze angacwebezeli nokuwaqinisa naku-kiln wash. Amabanga ayimpuphu kakhulu kuphela ancibilika ngokuphelele ku-glaze.
low-hazard-nuisance-dust-avoid-breathing: Uthuli oluyinkathazo olunengozi encane; gwema ukuluhogela.
blended-cornish-china-clay-from-imerys-6: I-china clay yaseCornwall exutshiwe evela ku-Imerys ene-titania encane kakhulu ne-K2O ecishe ibe ngu-2%, ngakho ishisa ibe mhlophe ngokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka. Iyi-kaolin evamile ezimbumbeni ze-porcelain zase-UK nasezindleleni eziningi zokwenza ama-glaze zase-UK.
fine-dust-may-contain-traces-of-1caabb5: Uthuli oluyimpuphu; lungaqukatha i-silica eyikristalu encane kakhulu.
imerys-cornish-china-clay-with-more-1xib: I-china clay yaseCornwall ye-Imerys ethambe kakhulu ene-iron ne-potash encane kancane kune-Grolleg; ishisa ibe mhlophe kakhulu. Yenzelwe izimbumba ze-porcelain futhi isetshenziswa kuma-glaze njenganoma iyiphi i-kaolin.
imerys-calcined-cornish-china-clay-about: I-calcined china clay yaseCornwall ye-Imerys (cishe i-mullite engu-55%, ingilazi engu-45%). Amabanga ayimpuphu angena esikhundleni sengxenye yobumba oluhlaza kuma-glaze anobumba obuningi ukuze kuncishiswe ukushwabana ne-crawling, futhi akhuphula kancane izinga lokushisa lokuvuthwa.
high-silica-devon-ball-clay-with-all38y: I-ball clay yaseDevon ene-silica eningi, ethambe kahle, enamandla aphakathi ne-iron encane; ishisa ibe ngu-ivory buff. I-ball clay evamile kuma-glaze nakuma-slip ase-UK.
dorset-ball-clay-with-high-strength-cu8i: I-ball clay yaseDorset enamandla amakhulu ne-iron eningana (cishe i-Fe2O3 engu-2.3%), esetshenziswa ezimbumbeni ze-stoneware ezinemibala efudumele nakwamanye ama-glaze nama-slip ase-UK.
low-plasticity-white-firing-ball-clay-2z: I-ball clay engathambile kakhulu, eshisa ibe mhlophe, ethengiswa yi-Potclays, edumile ezimbumbeni ze-stoneware; ishisa ibe mhlophe kakhulu kune-TWVA.
blend-of-medium-plasticity-white-firing-: Ingxube yama-ball clay athambe ngokuphakathi ashisa abe mhlophe. I-Potclays iyithengisa njengengena esikhundleni se-ESVA ball clay, abakhiqizi abayiyeka.
potclays-potash-feldspar-almost-no-soda-: I-potash feldspar ye-Potclays: cishe ayinayo i-soda futhi ine-silica ekhululekile eyengeziwe, ngakho ine-alumina encane kunama-potash spar amaningi. Amanani ayizindawo ezimaphakathi zamabanga ashicilelwe.
long-standing-uk-catalogue-figures-for-q: Izibalo zekhathalogu zase-UK ezikade zikhona ze-potash feldspar, ezishicilelwe yi-Potterycrafts, i-Bath Potters ne-CTM. I-Bath Potters ithi i-potash feldspar yayo ivela eNorway.
potterycrafts-data-sheet-for-p3296-octob: Ishidi lemininingwane le-Potterycrafts le-P3296 (Okthoba 2025) linikeza ukuhlaziywa kwe-Norflux K 11 ye-Sibelco esikhundleni (K₂O 11.8, Na₂O 2.9), ngakho isitoko sayo samanje singaba yileyo feldspar: bheka i-Norflux Potash Feldspar.
valentine-clays-potash-feldspar-a-typica: I-potash feldspar ye-Valentine Clays, i-potash spar evamile ene-K2O ecishe ibe ngu-10.4% ne-Na2O engu-2.3%.
spanish-sodium-feldspar-albite-with-almo: I-sodium feldspar yaseSpain (i-albite) ecishe ingenayo i-potash, ethengiswa yi-Potclays, i-Potterycrafts ne-Valentine nokuhlaziywa okufanayo. I-flux enamandla, encibilika kalula kune-potash feldspar.
the-soda-feldspar-figures-printed-by-pm7: Izibalo ze-soda feldspar ezishicilelwe yi-Bath Potters ne-CTM; i-Bath Potters ithi ivela eNorway.
mixed-potash-soda-feldspar-about-7-uyikr: I-potash-soda feldspar exutshiwe (cishe i-K2O engu-7%, i-Na2O engu-5%) evela endaweni ye-flotation ye-Sibelco eFinland. Le yi-''FFF'' ethengiswa yi-Potclays, i-Potterycrafts, i-Valentine ne-CTM; igama lisho i-Finnish Flotation Feldspar.
finnish-feldspar-quartz-pegmatite-that-p: I-feldspar-quartz pegmatite yaseFinland i-Potclays eyithengisa esikhundleni se-Forshammar feldspar engasatholakali. I-silica yayo eningi iyenza iziphathe kakhulu njenge-Cornish stone kune-feldspar yangempela.
the-nepheline-syenite-sold-in-the-1x77jq: I-nepheline syenite ethengiswa e-UK ivela eNorway, ine-K2O ne-Na2O ecishe ilingane. Izindlela zokwenza zase-US zicabanga i-A270 yaseCanada (K2O 4.8, Na2O 10.5), ngakho lezi zombili azishintshaniseki ngaphandle kokubala kabusha.
fine-dust-low-in-free-silica-1tgmsj5: Uthuli oluyimpuphu; lune-silica ekhululekile encane kodwa gwema ukuluhogela.
natural-cornish-stone-is-no-longer-1o4yc: I-Cornish stone yemvelo ayisambiwa, ngakho abaphakeli base-UK manje bathengisa engena esikhundleni sayo. I-FCS2 ye-Valentine ''iyi-flux exubile egayiwe eyenzelwe ukufana nezici zokushisa ze-Cornish Stone''; incibilika ku-1100-1300 °C.
the-leadless-frit-most-used-in-r48r5w: I-frit engenamthofu esetshenziswa kakhulu kuma-glaze e-earthenware ase-UK: i-calcium borosilicate ene-B2O3 ecishe ibe ngu-19%. Ibanga lokushisa 900-1050 °C (Bath Potters) noma 950-1150 °C (Potclays).
not-classified-ctm-standard-borax-frit-1: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (CTM Standard Borax Frit SDS 36, esetshenziswa njengelinganayo); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
potterycrafts-standard-borax-frit-a-gene: I-standard borax frit ye-Potterycrafts, i-frit engenamthofu yezinjongo ezijwayelekile yama-glaze e-earthenware. Ukwanda 8.3 x 10^-6/°C, ibanga lokushisa 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2953-u: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (Potterycrafts SDS P2953; i-quartz ingaphansi kuka-1%); ukuhogela uthuli isikhathi eside kwandisa ingozi yesifo samaphaphu.
soft-fluid-high-expansion-alkaline-frit-: I-alkaline frit ethambile, egelezayo, enokwanda okukhulu yama-glaze e-crackle ne-raku nama-copper blue e-alkaline. Ukwanda 13.4 x 10^-6/°C, ibanga lokushisa 880-1060 °C.
contains-barium-about-7-bao-soluble-1xab: Kuqukethe i-barium (cishe i-BaO engu-7%); i-alkaline frit encibilikayo emanzini, gwema ukuyigwinya.
newer-uk-high-alkaline-frit-with-1swirl0: I-high alkaline frit entsha yase-UK ene-soda ne-potash ecishe ilingane (cishe ngu-17% ngamunye) futhi engenayo i-barium; yama-glaze e-crackle nama-copper blue. Ibanga lokushisa 860-1060 °C.
very-soluble-alkaline-frit-avoid-ingesti: I-alkaline frit encibilika kakhulu emanzini; gwema ukuyigwinya.
sodium-borosilicate-frit-with-about-25-a: I-sodium borosilicate frit ene-B2O3 ecishe ibe ngu-25% futhi ecishe ingenayo i-lime, etuswa kuma-glaze e-copper turquoise. Ukwanda 6.9 x 10^-6/°C, ibanga lokushisa 900-1100 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2961-b: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (Potterycrafts SDS P2961); ukuhogela uthuli isikhathi eside kwandisa ingozi yesifo samaphaphu.
uk-fritted-calcium-borate-used-in-nlgcqo: I-calcium borate eyenziwe i-frit yase-UK esetshenziswa esikhundleni se-colemanite noma ye-Gerstley borate (cishe i-B2O3 engu-50%, i-CaO engu-26.5%). Ukwanda 6.1 x 10^-6/°C, ibanga lokushisa 1050-1160 °C. Yayitholakala ku-Potterycrafts ngo-Okthoba 2026.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2954-b: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (Potterycrafts SDS P2954); ukuhogela uthuli isikhathi eside kwandisa ingozi yesifo samaphaphu.
potclays-calcium-borate-frit-long-establ: I-calcium borate frit ye-Potclays, ''kade yaziwa njengengena esikhundleni se-colemanite kuma-glaze''. I-frit emanzi kancane, emahhadla; ibanga lokushisa 800-1100 °C, ayisiyo yokushisa ngokushesha.
not-classified-equivalent-potterycrafts-: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (i-Potterycrafts P2954 SDS elinganayo; ishidi le-calcium borate frit le-Bath Potters lithi akudingeki ilebula); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
ctm-s-calcium-borate-frit-on-1ttusd1: I-calcium borate frit ye-CTM, eyayithengiswa kwaze kwaba okungenani ngo-2019 futhi ''ingatholakali'' ngoDisemba 2025. Ukuhlaziywa yilokho okwashicilelwa ohlwini lwamanani lwe-CTM kusukela ngo-2016 kuya ku-2026 (kuyafana ne-Potterycrafts P2954); ikhasi le-web lama-frit le-CTM linikeza ukuhlaziywa okudala (SiO₂ 24, Al₂O₃ 8, B₂O₃ 41, CaO 22). not-classified-ctm-sds-37-avoid-o1fm3n: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (CTM SDS 37); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
leadless-low-expansion-frit-small-additi: I-frit engenamthofu enokwanda okuphansi; ukwengeza okuncane kukhuphula ukumelana kwe-glaze ne-crazing, amanani amakhulu enza kube nobisi. Ibanga lokushisa 1020-1150 °C (Bath Potters) noma 1040-1100 °C (Potclays). Ishidi le-Potclays, ne-Bath Potters eyalandela, lishicilela i-Li₂O 0.10, okushiya ukuhlaziywa ku-99.0%. Ifomula ye-Potclays uqobo ekhasini elifanayo (0.176 Li₂O) inikeza u-1.06%, njengoba kwenza i-Potterycrafts P2960 ecishe ifane, ngakho kusetshenziswa u-1.1.
not-classified-equivalent-potterycrafts-: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (i-Potterycrafts P2960 SDS elinganayo); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
low-expansion-borax-frit-used-to-1bguah0: I-borax frit enokwanda okuphansi esetshenziselwa ukunciphisa ukwanda kwe-glaze lapho i-crazing iyinkinga; ngaphezu kuka-5% ingafiphalisa ubuso. Ukwanda 3.8 x 10^-6/°C, ibanga lokushisa 1020-1150 °C.
not-classified-potterycrafts-sds-p2960-b: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (Potterycrafts SDS P2960); ukuhogela uthuli isikhathi eside kwandisa ingozi yesifo samaphaphu.
a-true-lead-bisilicate-65-66-1ics0hr: I-lead bisilicate ''yangempela'' (umthofu (lead, Pb): PbO engu-65-66%, SiO2 engu-32%, Al2O3 engu-2%) esathengiswa e-UK njenge-frit evamile yama-glaze e-earthenware ancibilika kancane; ukushisa 880-1050 °C (Potclays).
lead-frit-toxic-if-the-dust-1fnhzt2: I-frit yomthofu (lead, Pb): inoshevu uma uthuli luhogelwa noma lugwinywa. higher-lead-frit-1-pbo-to-1je72om: I-frit enomthofu (lead, Pb) omningi (1 PbO ku-1.5 SiO2) ethengiswa yi-Potclays ne-Bath Potters ''yama-glaze obuciko lapho ukuphepha ekudleni kungadingeki''. Ibanga lokushisa 860-1040 °C (Potclays).

a-pink-purple-basic-cobalt-carbonate-1xj: I-basic cobalt carbonate epinki-nsomi ene-cobalt engu-45–47%, ngakho cishe i-CoO engu-58%; okusele (cishe ngu-42%) kuyasha kuphume njenge-CO2 namanzi. Isabalala ngokulinganayo kakhulu kune-cobalt oxide; sebenzisa okuphindwe cishe ka-1.5 ukuze uthole okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okufanayo.
danger-potterycrafts-sds-matching-the-eu: Ingozi (Potterycrafts SDS, ivumelana nokuhlukaniswa okuvumelanisiwe kwe-EU): H302 kuyalimaza uma kugwinyiwe; H332 kuyalimaza uma kuhogelwa; H317 kungabangela ukungezwani nesikhumba; H334 kungabangela ukungezwani nomzimba noma izimpawu zesifuba somoya uma kuhogelwa; H341 kusolwa ukuthi kubangela ukukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo; H350i kungabangela umdlavuza ngokuhogela; H360F kungalimaza ukuzala; H400/H410 kunoshevu omkhulu ezintweni eziphila emanzini.
black-copper-oxide-cuo-about-98-1hdqa68: I-copper oxide emnyama, i-CuO, ehlanzeke cishe ngo-98% (i-copper engu-78–79%). Incibilika cishe ku-1326 C (2419 F), kodwa emoyeni iqale ilahlekelwe yi-oxygen ibe yi-Cu₂O kusukela cishe ku-1010–1030 C. I-flux enamandla, esebenzayo engenza ama-glaze agobhoze; i-copper iya ngokuya iba umusi uma idlula cishe u-1025 C (1877 F) futhi ingenza amabala ezitsheni eziseduze, ikakhulukazi ama-tin white. Inamahhadla kune-carbonate, ngakho ingenza amachashaza. Uma idlula cishe u-5% ingenza ubuso obumnyama obufana nensimbi obungafanele izitsha zokudla.
warning-potterycrafts-sds-h400-very-toxi: Isexwayiso (Potterycrafts SDS): H400 kunoshevu omkhulu ezintweni eziphila emanzini; ukuhlukaniswa okuvumelanisiwe kwe-EU kungu-H400 no-H410. Ama-SDS ase-US (Laguna, avela ku-Phibro) anikeza i-H302 kuyalimaza uma kugwinyiwe. Intuthu ye-copper evela kuma-kiln ashisayo ibangela i-metal fume fever; khipha umoya ku-kiln.
basic-copper-carbonate-a-green-powder-sh: I-basic copper carbonate, impuphu eluhlaza okotshani ene-copper engu-55–57%, ngakho cishe i-CuO engu-70%; okusele (cishe ngu-30%) kuphuma njenge-CO₂ namanzi kusukela cishe ku-290 C (554 F). Ayincibiliki. Inikeza umbala olinganayo kakhulu kune-copper oxide emnyama. I-flux esebenzayo; iba intuthu kusukela cishe ku-815 C (1500 F) futhi ingenza amabala ezitsheni eziseduze, ikakhulukazi ama-tin white.
warning-ceramic-color-chemical-sds-00909: Isexwayiso (Ceramic Color & Chemical SDS 00909-A, 2024-09, ethengiswa nge-The Ceramic Shop): H302 kuyalimaza uma kugwinyiwe; H332 kuyalimaza uma kuhogelwa; H319 kucasula kakhulu amehlo; H400/H410 kunoshevu omkhulu ezintweni eziphila emanzini.
not-classified-ctm-sds-31-32-7ac3hh: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (CTM SDS 31/32; i-quartz ingaphansi kuka-0.1%); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
magnetite-fe3o4-also-sold-as-magnetic-1j: I-magnetite, Fe₃O₄, ethengiswa futhi njenge-magnetic iron oxide; amanye amabanga ayitshe lemvelo eligayiwe eliqukethe i-quartz. Izincwadi ezindala zababumbi zibala i-black iron njenge-FeO, kodwa i-ferrous oxide ayithengiswa njengokokwakha kombumbi. Igremu ngegremu inikeza i-iron ecishe ilingane neye-red iron oxide. I-flux enamandla ku-reduction. Ivame ukuba namahhadla kune-red iron oxide; yihlunge noma uyigaye nge-ball mill ukuze ugweme amachashaza.
not-classified-ctm-sds-66-avoid-17wgk3h: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (CTM SDS 66); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
a-hydrated-form-of-iron-oxide-1pqopi1: Uhlobo lwe-iron oxide olunamanzi (hydrated). Alincibiliki emanzini, izinhlayiya ezincane kakhulu.
not-classified-ctm-sds-73-synthetic-1e8x: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (CTM SDS 73, i-yellow iron oxide eyenziwe); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
a-material-with-hydrated-iron-oxide-1kzy: Okokwakha okune-iron oxide enamanzi nobumba. Kwesinye isikhathi kubizwa ngokuthi yi-limonite (njengeminerali ye-iron oxide). Okuningi kuphinde kube ne-manganese.
danger-new-riverside-ochre-sds-natural-1: Ingozi (New Riverside Ochre SDS): i-ochre yemvelo ene-quartz engu-20–29% (i-carcinogen category 1A ngokuhogela; ingabangela i-silicosis) ne-manganese dioxide engu-1.5–4%; gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
potters-manganese-dioxide-is-ground-ore-: I-manganese dioxide yababumbi iyitshe eligayiwe, ngokuvamile cishe i-MnO₂ engu-75% ne-iron oxide, i-silica ne-alumina, ngakho inikeza i-MnO ecishe ibe ngu-61% kuphela. Ilahlekelwa yi-oxygen ngezigaba njengoba ishisa, ibe yi-Mn₂O₃ cishe ku-450–600 C ne-Mn₃O₄ cishe ku-750–1100 C; igesi ingabangela amabhamuza. Imibala ensundu, nensomi kuma-glaze e-alkaline; i-flux uma isincibilikile. I-manganese iba intuthu emazingeni okushisa aphezulu, ngakho khipha umoya ku-kiln.
warning-potterycrafts-sds-also-laguna-pr: Isexwayiso (Potterycrafts SDS; futhi i-Laguna/Prince BrickOx SDS; okuvumelanisiwe kwe-EU): H302 kuyalimaza uma kugwinyiwe; H332 kuyalimaza uma kuhogelwa. Amabanga etshe angaqukatha ne-silica eyikristalu. I-manganese iba intuthu emazingeni okushisa aphezulu, ngakho khipha umoya ku-kiln.
green-nickel-oxide-is-stoichiometric-nio: I-nickel oxide eluhlaza okotshani iyi-NiO e-stoichiometric, i-nickel engu-78.5%. Ayihlakazeki futhi ayincibiliki ku-kiln (i-NiO incibilika cishe ku-1955 C / 3550 F) futhi imelana nokushisa, ngakho sebenzisa amanani amancane; inikeza imibala eluhlaza okotshani efiphele, ensundu nempunga, nokuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka noma okupinki kwezinye izisekelo.
danger-laguna-nickel-oxide-sds-ghs-1vgqp: Ingozi (Laguna nickel oxide SDS, inguqulo ye-GHS 06/15): H317 kungabangela ukungezwani nesikhumba; H334 kungabangela ukungezwani nomzimba noma izimpawu zesifuba somoya uma kuhogelwa; H350 kungabangela umdlavuza (EU: H350i, ngokuhogela); H372 kulimaza amaphaphu uma kuhogelwa isikhathi eside noma kuphindaphindwa; H413 kungabangela umonakalo ohlala isikhathi eside ezintweni eziphila emanzini.
black-nickel-oxide-is-nio-with-kerajy: I-nickel oxide emnyama iyi-NiO ene-oxygen eyengeziwe encane (cishe i-nickel engu-76.4–77.6%), hhayi i-Ni2O3 yangempela. Ilahlekelwa yileyo oxygen futhi ibe yi-NiO eluhlaza okotshani cishe ku-600–700 C (1100–1300 F), ngakho ku-glaze iziphatha njenge-nickel oxide eluhlaza okotshani, inikeza i-NiO encane ngo-2% igremu ngalinye.
danger-laguna-nickel-oxide-sds-ghs-wakl3: Ingozi (Laguna nickel oxide SDS, inguqulo ye-GHS 06/15, ebiza amabanga e-calcined black nickel oxide A no-F): H317 kungabangela ukungezwani nesikhumba; H334 kungabangela ukungezwani nomzimba noma izimpawu zesifuba somoya uma kuhogelwa; H350 kungabangela umdlavuza (EU: H350i, ngokuhogela); H372 kulimaza amaphaphu uma kuhogelwa isikhathi eside noma kuphindaphindwa; H413 kungabangela umonakalo ohlala isikhathi eside ezintweni eziphila emanzini.
pr6o11-the-dark-brown-form-that-n56z4j: I-Pr₆O₁₁, uhlobo olunsundu olumnyama oluthengiswayo. Lapha ibalwa njenge-Pr₂O₃, uhlobo i-praseodymium eluthatha ku-glaze; i-oxygen eyengeziwe (3.1%) nomswakama ofika ku-1% kubalwa njenge-loss on ignition. Ayincibiliki ku-kiln (cishe ku-2183 C); u-931 C ovame ukushiwo ungowensimbi. Okokufaka umbala okubuthakathaka: u-5–8% unikeza okuluhlaza okotshani okufana ne-lime kuya kokuphuzi, futhi isetshenziswa kakhulu kuma-stain aphuzi e-zircon-praseodymium.
low-hazard-but-sdss-disagree-fujifilm-d1: Ingozi encane, kodwa ama-SDS awavumelani: i-Fujifilm Wako (2023) ayinangozi ngaphansi kwe-GHS; i-LTS (2023) Isexwayiso, H315, H319, H335 (ukucasula isikhumba, amehlo nemigudu yokuphefumula). Iningi labazisi be-ECHA alikuhlukanisi i-praseodymium oxide njengengozi.
natural-rutile-milled-for-ceramics-about: I-rutile yemvelo egayelwe i-ceramics: cishe i-TiO2 engu-95% enamanani amancane e-silica, i-zircon, i-vanadium, i-iron ne-chromium. Amabanga amanje ase-US nase-UK ane-iron oxide engaphansi kuka-1%, hhayi u-9–10% ovame ukucatshangwa. Isetshenziselwa imibala ehlukahlukene ye-tan kuya kokunsundu, ukungabonisi (opacity) nokukhula kwamakristalu, kanye ne-cobalt, i-copper noma i-iron yemibala ephukile.
tam-ceramics-sds-2018-warning-eye-1yrsyy: I-TAM Ceramics SDS (2018): Isexwayiso, kucasula amehlo nesikhumba (Category 2; H319, H315); uthuli lungacasula imigudu yokuphefumula. I-Potterycrafts SDS: akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi. Ukubalwa kwe-EU njenge-Carc. 2 kwempuphu ye-TiO2 ehogelwayo kwachithwa (2022, kwaqinisekiswa 2025).
tio2-added-at-about-2-10-wa6in9: I-TiO₂. Yengezwa cishe ku-2–10% (u-4% uvamile) ngemibala ehlukahlukene, ukungabonisi (opacity) nokukhula kwamakristalu, kanye ne-iron noma i-cobalt ngemibala ephukile. Isohlwini lokokwakha futhi njenge-Titanium Oxide, ezindleleni zokwenza eziyibala esisekelweni.
vanadium-pentoxide-v2o5-an-orange-yellow: I-vanadium pentoxide, V2O5, impuphu ewolintshi-phuzi, ehlanzeke cishe ngo-99%. Incibilika ku-690 C (1274 F) futhi isebenza njenge-flux; iyodwa inikeza okuphuzi okubuthakathaka kuya kokunsundu, futhi ne-tin oxide noma i-zircon okuphuzi okunamandla. Inoshevu kakhulu: gqoka i-respirator, gwema uthuli futhi ukhiphe umoya ku-kiln.
danger-eu-gb-harmonised-classification-h: Ingozi. Ukuhlukaniswa okuvumelanisiwe kwe-EU/GB: H301 kunoshevu uma kugwinyiwe, H330 kuyabulala uma kuhogelwa, H335 ukucasula imigudu yokuphefumula, H341 kusolwa ukuthi kubangela ukukhubazeka kwezakhi zofuzo, H350 kungabangela umdlavuza, H361fd kusolwa ukuthi kulimaza ukuzala noma ingane engakazalwa, H362 ukulimala kwezingane ezincela ibele, H372 ukulimala kwamaphaphu ngenxa yokuthintana okuphindaphindwayo, H411 kunoshevu ezintweni eziphila emanzini. stannic-oxide-sno2-about-99-5-14e5t2w: I-stannic oxide, SnO₂, ehlanzeke cishe ngo-99.5%. Ayincibiliki emazingeni okushisa e-glaze (incibilika cishe ku-1630 C / 2966 F); ihlala ixubekile njengezinhlayiya ezincane, okwenza i-glaze ingabonisi ngaphakathi: u-4–6% unikeza okumhlophe okungabonisi kancane, u-8–10% ukungabonisi okuphelele, nokumhlophe okufudumele ku-majolica eshiswe kancane. Yenza i-glaze ingabonisi kabi ku-reduction naku-cone 10, lapho iqala khona ukuncibilika. Isiza ukuthuthukisa ama-copper red ku-reduction; ne-chrome encane kakhulu iba pinki.
not-classified-no-signal-word-on-n0mh1: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (alikho igama lesixwayiso) kuma-SDS amanje (Potterycrafts 2025, Laguna 2014). Ukuhogela uthuli iminyaka eminingi kungabangela i-stannosis, isimo samaphaphu esingesibi.
zirconium-dioxide-zro2-zirconia-rarely-u: I-zirconium dioxide, ZrO₂ (i-zirconia). Ayivamile ukusetshenziswa iluhlaza kuma-glaze: izindlela zokwenza eziningi zidinga i-zircon (Zircopax, Superpax), eyi-zirconium silicate. Ayincibiliki emanzini; yenza i-glaze ingabonisi njengoba ihlala ingancibilikile emazingeni okushisa e-glaze, iqinisa okuncibilikile futhi inganciphisa i-crazing.
not-classified-ati-zirconium-oxide-sds-1: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (ATI zirconium oxide SDS, EU); gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
zirconium-silicate-zrsio4-67-2-zro2-i6z2: I-zirconium silicate, ZrSiO₄: i-ZrO₂ engu-67.2% ne-SiO₂ engu-32.8%. Ithengiswa njenge-Zircopax, i-Superpax, i-Excelopax, i-Ultrox ne-Zircosil, ezehluka ikakhulu ngobukhulu bezinhlayiya. Into evamile yokwenza i-glaze ingabonisi (opacifier): cishe u-4–7% ukuze ingabonisi kancane, u-8–15% noma ngaphezulu ukuze ingabonisi ngokuphelele; u-1–3% ikakhulu uqinisa i-glaze. Iyasebenza ku-reduction, ngokungafani ne-tin oxide. I-silica yayo ibalwa ku-glaze.
not-classified-ctm-zirconium-silicate-sd: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (CTM zirconium silicate SDS 29; i-silica eyikristalu ehogelwayo ingaphansi kuka-0.01%); ine-radioactivity encane (i-uranium 285–343 ppm, i-thorium 116–157 ppm), ngakho gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
synthetic-red-iron-oxide-is-about-1i5e3s: I-red iron oxide eyenziwe icishe ibe yi-Fe₂O₃ engu-99%; ama-red iron oxide emvelo (i-hematite egayiwe) abuthakathaka, cishe i-Fe₂O₃ engu-76–95% enobumba, i-quartz ne-carbonate. Into eqinisa emelana nokushisa ku-oxidation kuze kube cishe ku-cone 7–8, lapho iqala ukulahlekelwa yi-oxygen futhi ibe yi-flux; ku-reduction iba yi-FeO kusenesikhathi futhi iyi-flux enamandla.
synthetic-grade-not-classified-as-hazard: Ibanga elenziwe: alihlukaniswanga njengengozi (Potterycrafts SDS P3441, rev 2025-10). Amabanga etshe lemvelo afakwa ilebula ethi Isexwayiso, H373 (ukulimala kwamaphaphu ngenxa yokuhogela isikhathi eside) ngoba aqukethe i-quartz ehogelwayo.
wyoming-sodium-bentonite-the-standard-gl: I-sodium bentonite yase-Wyoming, into ejwayelekile yokugcina i-glaze ixubekile; u-1–3% uvimbela i-glaze ukuthi izike, kodwa okuningi kwenza yome kancane futhi ithambekele ku-crawling. Yengeza i-iron, i-soda ne-magnesia encane.
danger-h350-may-cause-cancer-by-qzjuvp: Ingozi: H350 kungabangela umdlavuza (ngokuhogela) ne-H372 kulimaza amaphaphu uma ukuthintana nakho kuthatha isikhathi eside noma kuphindaphindwa, ngoba kuqukethe i-silica eyikristalu (Volclay 325: i-quartz kuze kufike ku-6%, i-cristobalite kuze kufike ku-2%). Gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
a-water-washed-white-firing-smectite-11s: Ubumba lwe-smectite olugezwe ngamanzi, olushisa lube mhlophe (i-magnesium aluminium silicate) olusetshenziswa ku-1–2% njengokugcina i-glaze ixubekile nokuyiqinisa futhi njengokwenza i-porcelain nezinye izimbumba ezingathambile zithambe. Lugcwalise ngamanzi ngokuphelele ngaphambi kokwengeza okunye okokwakha. I-Vanderbilt ayishicileli ukuhlaziywa kwama-oxide ebanga T; lokhu kungokwe-VEEGUM evamile, okucashunwe kwi-patent ka-1964, ngakho kuthathe njengokulinganiselwa. Ine-magnesium eningi (MgO 13.7%), ngokungafani ne-sodium bentonite.
not-classified-vanderbilt-sds-2023-no-17: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (Vanderbilt SDS 2023): alikho igama lesixwayiso. Gwema ukuhogela uthuli; ukuhogela isikhathi eside kungalimaza amaphaphu.
a-purified-hectorite-magnesium-lithium-s: Ubumba lwe-hectorite oluhlanziwe (i-magnesium-lithium smectite), manje oluthengiswa njenge-Elementis Bentone MA; lugcina ama-glaze exubekile futhi luqinisa ungqimba olomile ngaphandle kokwehlisa ijubane lokoma njenge-CMC. Ngokungafani ne-bentonite luletha i-magnesia, i-lime ne-lithia encane kunokuba i-alumina ne-iron.
not-classified-elementis-sds-2016-not-j7: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (Elementis SDS 2016): akuyona into eyingozi ngaphansi kwe-GHS. Gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
an-organic-gum-that-binds-and-pg9ere: I-gum yemvelo ebophayo neqinisa ungqimba lwe-glaze olomile, yehlisa ijubane lokoma futhi isize ekuxubheni ngebhulashi; iyasha iphele ekushiseni futhi ayibalwa emakhemikhalini. Izixazululo ziyabola, ngakho yenza ama-batch amancane noma wengeze into evimbela ukubola.
warning-may-form-combustible-dust-concen: Isexwayiso: kungakha uthuli olungasha uma luminyene emoyeni (OSHA combustible dust). Akukho ukuhlukaniswa kwengozi empilweni.
a-soluble-salt-used-in-tiny-1g4n6wq: Usawoti oncibilikayo osetshenziswa ngamanani amancane kakhulu ukwenza i-slurry ye-glaze ijiye (flocculate) ukuze ihlale ixubekile; kuwukulungisa inqubo, akuyona ngempela ingxenye ye-glaze. Iningi lesisindo sawo lingamanzi ne-sulfate, okuphuma ngesikhathi sokushisa.
not-classified-giles-chemical-sds-2020-1: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (Giles Chemical SDS 2020): akuyona into eyingozi ngaphansi kwe-GHS.
manganese-ii-carbonate-a-pinkish-tan-nrm: I-manganese(II) carbonate, impuphu ewu-tan opinki; amabanga okuhweba acishe abe yi-manganese engu-44% (i-MnCO3 ehlanzekile ingu-47.8%). Ibalwa njenge-MnO, cishe i-MnO engu-57% ne-loss on ignition ecishe ibe ngu-43% njengoba ikhipha i-CO2 kusukela cishe ku-200 C; inikeza imibala ensundu, nensomi kuya ku-plum kuma-glaze e-alkaline.
danger-h372-causes-damage-to-organs-18gj: Ingozi: H372, kulimaza izitho zomzimba (isimiso sezinzwa) uma kuhogelwa isikhathi eside noma kuphindaphindwa (Laguna SDS, rev. 2014-03; futhi isaziso se-ECHA esivame kakhulu). Gwema uthuli futhi ukhiphe umoya ku-kiln.
basic-nickel-carbonate-a-light-green-14r: I-basic nickel carbonate, impuphu eluhlaza okotshani okukhanyayo ethengiswa ine-nickel ecishe ibe ngu-46%. Ibalwa njenge-NiO, cishe i-NiO engu-58.5% ne-loss on ignition ecishe ibe ngu-41.5%; igesi eyikhiphayo ingenza amabhamuza ku-glaze. Inikeza imibala eluhlaza okotshani efiphele, empunga nensundu, futhi isetshenziselwa ukuthambisa ama-cobalt blue.
danger-h302-h332-harmful-if-swallowed-1e: Ingozi: H302+H332 kuyalimaza uma kugwinyiwe noma kuhogelwa; H315; H317 kubangela ukungezwani nesikhumba; H334 kubangela ukungezwani nemigudu yokuphefumula; H341; H350i kungabangela umdlavuza ngokuhogela; H360 kungalimaza ukuzala noma ingane engakazalwa; H372. Ukuhlukaniswa okuvumelanisiwe kwe-EU kunikeza i-H360D (kungalimaza ingane engakazalwa) futhi kwengeza i-H400/H410 (ezintweni eziphila emanzini). Gwema lonke uthuli.
sold-to-potters-as-ground-natural-1ijf67: Ithengiselwa ababumbi njengetshe lemvelo le-chromite eligayiwe elivela eNingizimu Afrika, hhayi i-chromate yangempela: cishe i-Cr2O3 engu-46% ne-FeO engu-26%, ne-alumina ne-magnesia. Imelana kakhulu nokushisa; inikeza okumpunga, okunsundu ne-zinc, okupinki kuya kokubomvu ne-tin, nokumnyama ne-cobalt.
not-classified-under-ghs-vibrantz-iron-h: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi ngaphansi kwe-GHS (Vibrantz ''Iron Chromite Chromox 7901'' SDS, rev. 2023-01, njengoba ithengiswa yi-Sounding Stone; futhi i-Prince Minerals SDS ye-Laguna). Gwema ukuhogela uthuli; imithombo yababumbi emidala ithi inoshevu kakhulu.
a-rare-earth-oxide-used-as-1yx4z2x: I-rare-earth oxide esetshenziswa njengento yokwenza i-glaze ingabonisi emazingeni okushisa aphansi nanjengokokufaka umbala okubuthakathaka, inikeza ukhilimu kuya ku-tan ophuzi noma owolintshi ikakhulukazi ne-titanium noma i-rutile. Izika ngokushesha, ngakho i-glaze idinga into yokuyigcina ixubekile.
not-classified-pace-sds-2025-not-1ao5xnh: Akuhlukaniswanga njengengozi (PACE SDS 2025): akuyona into eyingozi ngaphansi kwe-GHS. Abanye abaphakeli babala ukucasula amehlo, isikhumba nemigudu yokuphefumula (H315, H319, H335). Gwema ukuhogela uthuli.
natural-red-iron-oxide-mined-at-767hen: I-red iron oxide yemvelo embiwa e-Tierga, eSpain: cishe i-Fe2O3 engu-87% ene-silica, i-dolomite ne-mica ethile, ngakho igremu ngegremu ibuthakathaka kancane kune-red iron oxide eyenziwe. warning-h373-may-cause-damage-to-1vkarkk: Isexwayiso: H373, kungalimaza amaphaphu uma kuhogelwa isikhathi eside noma kuphindaphindwa, ngoba kuqukethe i-quartz ehogelwayo (Promindsa Micronox R series SDS, rev. 2015-01, esatshalaliswa yi-Laguna).
